repairs.old_challenge: Jer.1.11-Jer.1.16: The final span differs from Jer.1.11-Jer.1.12 plus Jer.1.13-Jer.1.19.

new_challenge.claim: The second seeing question at 1:13 starts the boiling-pot sign, so the paired-vision unit through 1:16 competes with treating 1:11-12 as an almond-branch exchange and 1:13-19 as a pot interpretation joined to its renewed commission.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Test whether the repeated question-answer form binds both signs more strongly than the 1:17 girding imperative binds commission to the second sign; if not, segment 1:11-12 and 1:13-19 while hydrating both inside the call narrative.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.1.17-Jer.1.19: The final span differs from Jer.1.13-Jer.1.19.

new_challenge.claim: The gird-yourself command at 1:17 resets the discourse into direct commissioning, yet its stand-and-speak charge answers the northern threat interpreted from the boiling pot in 1:13-16.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Adjudicate 1:17 as either a durable commission opening or the response phase of the 1:13 vision; preserve 1:17-19 as a retrievable child only with mandatory hydration to 1:13-16 if the former wins.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.3.19-Jer.3.25: The final span differs from Jer.3.19-Jer.4.2.

new_challenge.claim: The filial address, the voice on the bare heights, and the communal shame confession reach 3:25, but the conditional return clauses in 4:1-2 grammatically answer that confession before Judah receives a new address in 4:3.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Compare a cross-chapter dialogue at 3:19-4:2 against the current 3:19-25 unit; if the chapter seam remains active, link 4:1-2 back as the divine response rather than retrieving the confession without its answer.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.4.1-Jer.4.4: The final span differs from Jer.3.19-Jer.4.2 plus Jer.4.3-Jer.4.4.

new_challenge.claim: Verses 4:1-2 continue the return exchange addressed to Israel, whereas the thus-says introduction at 4:3 explicitly redirects the fallow-ground and heart-circumcision imperatives to Judah and Jerusalem.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Evaluate 3:19-4:2 and 4:3-4 as separate addressee-defined movements; retain 4:1-4 only if retrieval metadata exposes the internal 4:3 reset and hydrates 4:1-2 with the preceding confession.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.4.19-Jer.4.31: The final span differs from Jer.4.19-Jer.4.22 plus Jer.4.23-Jer.4.26 plus Jer.4.27-Jer.4.31.

new_challenge.claim: The passage moves from heard alarm and bodily anguish in 4:19-22 to four coordinated I-saw creation-reversal observations in 4:23-26, then to the not-a-full-end decree and Daughter Zion's labor cry in 4:27-31.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Pit the continuous city-lament arc against three form-marked children at 4:19-22, 4:23-26, and 4:27-31; if the larger unit remains primary, expose those seams and require parent hydration for each child.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.5.20-Jer.5.31: The final span differs from Jer.5.20-Jer.5.25 plus Jer.5.26-Jer.5.29 plus Jer.5.30-Jer.5.31.

new_challenge.claim: The house-of-Jacob creation disputation closes with withheld harvest in 5:25, the wicked-fowler social indictment reaches its vengeance question at 5:29, and an astonishing-horror exclamation opens the prophet-priest coda at 5:30.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Determine whether the repeated foolishness theme warrants one 5:20-31 oracle or three children at 5:20-25, 5:26-29, and 5:30-31, preserving a shared indictment parent when the smaller forms are surfaced.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.6.22-Jer.6.26: The final span differs from Jer.6.22-Jer.6.30.

new_challenge.claim: The nation-from-the-north announcement and weapon imagery lead Daughter Zion into sackcloth mourning through 6:26, while 6:27 changes the scene by commissioning Jeremiah as tester and introducing sustained metallurgical diction.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Review the 6:26/27 seam against the Hebrew shift from communal terror to assayer vocation; either keep 6:22-26 beside 6:27-30 or house both under a hydrated 6:22-30 terror-and-refining parent.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.6.27-Jer.6.30: The final span differs from Jer.6.22-Jer.6.30.

new_challenge.claim: The tester appointment at 6:27 initiates a distinct failed-assay scene whose bellows, lead, refining, and rejected-silver lexicon reaches closure at 6:30, although it diagnoses the people threatened in 6:22-26.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Retain 6:27-30 as an assayer child if the vocational address controls form, but attach a 6:22-30 parent relation so the refining verdict cannot be detached from the northern-army and mourning oracle.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.7.21-Jer.7.28: The final span differs from Jer.7.21-Jer.7.29.

new_challenge.claim: The add-your-burnt-offerings irony, obey-my-voice refrain, and backward-not-forward verdict culminate in the faithless-nation naming at 7:28, yet the feminine cut-off-your-hair lament command at 7:29 may function as that disputation's enacted coda.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Ask whether 7:29 closes the sacrifice-obedience speech or opens the Topheth sequence; compare 7:21-29 with 7:21-28 and record a directed link from whichever unit owns the lament command.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.7.29-Jer.8.3: The final span differs from Jer.7.21-Jer.7.29 plus Jer.7.30-Jer.8.3.

new_challenge.claim: The cut-hair imperative at 7:29 can cap the rejected-obedience disputation, whereas the children-of-Judah evil formula at 7:30 launches Topheth renaming, burial reversal, and exposed bones through 8:3.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Contrast the present lament-led 7:29-8:3 span with children 7:21-29 and 7:30-8:3; if 7:29 remains attached forward, annotate its backward rhetorical dependence on 7:21-28.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.8.4-Jer.8.17: The final span differs from Jer.8.4-Jer.8.7 plus Jer.8.8-Jer.8.12 plus Jer.8.13-Jer.8.17.

new_challenge.claim: Falling-and-turning questions govern 8:4-7, the claim to Torah wisdom and lying-pen reply reshape the address in 8:8-12, and failed harvest introduces invasion dialogue and uncharmable serpents in 8:13-17.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Test a single refusal-to-judgment progression against those three marker-defined pericopes; when 8:4-17 is retained, index 8:4-7, 8:8-12, and 8:13-17 as hydrated internal forms rather than flattening their voices.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.9.23-Jer.9.26: The final span differs from Jer.9.23-Jer.9.24 plus Jer.9.25-Jer.9.26.

new_challenge.claim: The balanced wisdom-might-riches prohibition resolves at 9:24 in knowing the covenant-practicing Lord, while the behold-days formula at 9:25 begins a catalogue about circumcised peoples and uncircumcised hearts.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Choose between one boasting-and-circumcision coda and paired sayings at 9:23-24 and 9:25-26; if joined, preserve the 9:25 oracle formula as a searchable internal boundary.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.11.1-Jer.11.8: The final span differs from Jer.11.1-Jer.11.17.

new_challenge.claim: The covenant word-event, public hear-the-covenant commission, iron-furnace history, Jeremiah's amen, and ancestral refusal form 11:1-8, but the conspiracy and olive-tree judgment in 11:9-17 continue the same breach vocabulary.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Assess whether the covenant frame overrides the 11:9 renewed divine address; maintain 11:1-8 as a proclamation child only if a 11:1-17 parent keeps the later conspiracy and beloved-house consequences in view.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.11.9-Jer.11.17: The final span differs from Jer.11.1-Jer.11.17.

new_challenge.claim: The Lord-said-to-me reset at 11:9 announces a discovered conspiracy and renews the intercession ban before beloved-house and kindled-olive imagery complete the judgment at 11:17.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Verify 11:9 as an oracle opening rather than a paragraph inside one covenant sermon; if split from 11:1-8, give both decisions common hydration under 11:1-17 instead of losing the breach-to-burning trajectory.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.11.9-Jer.11.17: The final span differs from Jer.11.9-Jer.11.14 plus Jer.11.15-Jer.11.17.

new_challenge.claim: The prose conspiracy indictment and no-prayer command finish at 11:14, after which the beloved-house question, holy flesh, green olive, and burning branches create a compact poetic oracle in 11:15-17.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Compare the integrated conspiracy-to-fire judgment with literary children 11:9-14 and 11:15-17; should the children prevail, bind the olive poem to its conspiracy cause through explicit sibling and parent relations.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.12.7-Jer.12.13: The final span differs from Jer.12.7-Jer.12.17.

new_challenge.claim: First-person abandonment of house and inheritance unfolds through lion, bird, shepherd, vineyard, and failed-harvest images to 12:13, whereas the thus-says formula at 12:14 turns toward neighboring peoples and conditional restoration.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Treat 12:14 as the candidate boundary and compare the two-unit route with a single 12:7-17 inheritance oracle; if divided, hydrate the lament and neighbor ruling under that broader inheritance movement.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.12.14-Jer.12.17: The final span differs from Jer.12.7-Jer.12.17.

new_challenge.claim: At 12:14 an explicit thus-says address names evil neighbors and balances uprooting with learning, rebuilding, or destruction, a conditional addressee structure absent from the preceding devastated-inheritance lament.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Keep 12:14-17 independently retrievable when the address reset controls segmentation, while adding a 12:7-17 parent that preserves the repeated inheritance lexeme and lament-to-restoration reversal.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.13.15-Jer.13.27: The final span differs from Jer.13.15-Jer.13.17 plus Jer.13.18-Jer.13.19 plus Jer.13.20-Jer.13.27.

new_challenge.claim: Listen-and-do-not-be-proud with hidden weeping shapes 13:15-17, the king and queen mother become direct addressees in 13:18-19, and the northward look at 13:20 opens Daughter Jerusalem's labor, scattering, and exposure oracle.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Weigh a continuous pride-to-shame sequence against three speech-form children at 13:15-17, 13:18-19, and 13:20-27; if kept whole, surface both addressee changes and hydrate each child to 13:15-27.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.14.1-Jer.14.6: The final span differs from Jer.14.1-Jer.14.22.

new_challenge.claim: The drought heading introduces a third-person tableau of mourning gates, empty vessels, ashamed farmers, abandoned fawns, and breathless wild donkeys through 14:6 before communal first-person confession begins at 14:7.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Test the scene-and-speaker boundary at 14:6/7 against the Hebrew specialist's single 14:1-22 drought dialogue; retain 14:1-6 as a tableau child with parent hydration if the larger cycle remains essential.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.14.7-Jer.14.12: The final span differs from Jer.14.1-Jer.14.22.

new_challenge.claim: Communal confession invokes the Hope of Israel in 14:7-9, and the divine reply in 14:10-12 rejects wandering, prayer, fasting, and sacrifice, creating a bounded failed-intercession exchange within the drought cycle.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Evaluate the prayer-and-refusal pair as 14:7-12 while retaining a 14:1-22 dialogue parent; a whole-cycle route must still expose the change from land tableau to communal plea at 14:7.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.14.13-Jer.14.18: The final span differs from Jer.14.1-Jer.14.22.

new_challenge.claim: Jeremiah's objection about promised peace at 14:13 receives a lying-vision verdict and matched prophet-audience judgment through 14:16, followed by a commanded night-and-day tears speech in 14:17-18.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Decide whether the false-prophet dispute and commissioned lament form one 14:13-18 response or remain inseparable from 14:1-22; whichever level leads, mark the 14:13 speaker turn and 14:17 speech commission.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.14.19-Jer.14.22: The final span differs from Jer.14.1-Jer.14.22.

new_challenge.claim: Rejection and failed-healing questions at 14:19 open a communal confession that appeals to covenant and closes by contrasting rainless idols with waiting for the Creator in 14:22.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Judge this closing rain petition as a discrete lament nested in 14:1-22, or keep the entire drought sequence primary while registering 14:19 as its final supplicant turn before the Moses-and-Samuel refusal in 15:1.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.15.10-Jer.15.21: The final span differs from Jer.15.10-Jer.15.14 plus Jer.15.15-Jer.15.21.

new_challenge.claim: The birth curse and universal-litigant complaint receive reassurance and an iron-breaking exile answer in 15:10-14, while remember-me, eaten-word, and deceptive-waters language begins another confession answered by recommission in 15:15-21.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Compare one vocational confession with paired complaint-response movements at 15:10-14 and 15:15-21; if unified, encode 15:15 as a prayer reset so the second recommission remains separately discoverable.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.16.14-Jer.16.15: The final span differs from Jer.16.14-Jer.16.21.

new_challenge.claim: The coming-days oath reversal in 16:14-15 replaces Egypt with northern and dispersed deliverance and returns the people to ancestral soil, reaching restorative closure before fishers and hunters are summoned in 16:16.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Set the oath saying against a single 16:14-21 return-judgment-recognition oracle; if 16:14-15 stands alone, supply a parent link that keeps its restoration beside the pursuit and nations material.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.16.16-Jer.16.18: The final span differs from Jer.16.14-Jer.16.21.

new_challenge.claim: The behold-I-send summons in 16:16 shifts from return oath to fishers and hunters who expose every hiding place, and double repayment for land pollution completes that pursuit judgment at 16:18.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Examine 16:16 and 16:19 as the two edges of a judgment child; use 16:14-21 as its hydration parent if the specialist's unified recognition arc is retained above the child level.

repairs.old_challenge: Jer.16.19-Jer.16.21: The final span differs from Jer.16.14-Jer.16.21.

new_challenge.claim: The refuge invocation at 16:19 changes voice after the repayment oracle, anticipates nations confessing inherited falsehood, and culminates in the divine this-time declaration that they will know the name.
new_challenge.proposed_remedy: Assess 16:19-21 as a nations-confession and self-disclosure coda alongside the broader 16:14-21 arc; when independently indexed, hydrate it backward to both the new-exodus oath and fisher-hunter judgment.
